en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a central town hall building with a high clock tower topped by a bulbous dome and small lantern. The ground floor has shops and arcades, with a horse‑drawn cart and several pedestrians in the square in front. Printed captions in three languages at the bottom identify the building and town; handwritten message in ink covers part of the lower margin. The reverse side has the typical divided postcard layout with Hungarian text "LEVELEZŐ-LAP", address written in cursive, postage stamps and postmarks.
